title: Uruguayan Beef Wrap
description: A simple and flavorful Uruguayan-inspired beef wrap recipe. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan beef (such as skirt steak or flank steak)
Quietly roasted onions
ingredients.notes: Sliced and roasted in a 350°F oven for 20 minutes

ingredients.name: Optional: sliced bell peppers and/or zucchini

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, warm the wrap in the microwave or in a dry skillet.
Assemble the wrap by spreading chimichurri sauce on the bottom half of the wrap, then layering with sliced beef, roasted onions, and any desired toppings.
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
